items.exampleEn: Could you speak up? I can't hear you.
items.exampleZh: 你可以大聲一點嗎？我聽不到。

items.exampleEn: The band split up after their third album.
items.exampleZh: 這個樂團在第三張專輯後就拆夥了。

items.exampleEn: I always stick to my decisions once I make them.
items.exampleZh: 我一旦做了決定，就會一直堅持下去。

items.exampleEn: Why did they tear down that beautiful old house?
items.exampleZh: 他們為什麼把那棟漂亮的老房子拆了？

items.exampleEn: Your desk really needs tidying up.
items.exampleZh: 你的桌子真的需要整理一下了。

items.exampleEn: You can try the bike out before you buy it.
items.exampleZh: 你可以先試騎這輛腳踏車再決定買不買。

items.exampleEn: Let's wrap things up for today.
items.exampleZh: 我們今天就到這裡收尾吧。

items.sentenceEn: The kids tidied their room up without being asked.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們沒人叫就自己把房間整理乾淨了。

items.audioEn: The gym lets you try out all the machines for free during your first week.
items.audioZh: 這間健身房讓你在第一週免費試用所有器材。
options: Use the equipment at no cost
Take free swimming lessons every morning
Get a discount on a yearly card
Bring a friend at no extra cost

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather sticks to the same breakfast every day.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺每天固定吃同樣的早餐。

items.sentenceEn: If you disagree with the plan, please speak up.
items.sentenceZh: 如果你不同意這個計畫，請說出來。

items.stemEn: Workers spent three months ____ the old bridge piece by piece.
items.stemZh: 工人花了三個月，一塊一塊地拆除那座舊橋。

items.stemEn: After ten years together, the two business partners ____ and started their own companies.
items.stemZh: 合作了十年後，兩位事業夥伴拆夥，各自開了公司。

items.passageEn: Next month, workers will tear the old gym down and build a modern sports center. Before the work starts, the students have to tidy up the storage rooms and move everything out. Our class meeting on Monday ran long, so the teacher asked us to decide quickly. When she asked for volunteers, Ben was the first to speak up. In the end, we split up into three groups, and each group will clean one room.
items.passageZh: 下個月，工人會拆除我們學校的舊體育館，蓋一座新式的運動中心。動工之前，學生得把儲藏室整理乾淨，並把東西全部搬出來。星期一的班會開得太久，所以老師要我們快點決定。老師徵求志工時，Ben 第一個開口。最後，我們分成三組，每組負責打掃一間儲藏室。

questions.questionZh: 學校為什麼要學生整理儲藏室？
options: 學校要把儲藏室改成教室
老師要檢查儲藏室裡的東西

questions.questionZh: 最後全班怎麼分配工作？
options: 每個人各自負責整理一個櫃子
分成三組，每組打掃一間

items.promptZh: 無論如何，我們都不能超出預算。
referenceEn: No matter what, we have to stick to the budget.
Whatever happens, we must stick to our budget.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「不超出」（例如 stick to the budget 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 stay within the budget、keep to the budget 等）
「必須」可寫，例如 have to、must 等
「無論如何」可寫，例如 no matter what、whatever happens 等

items.promptZh: 我們十分鐘後結束這堂課。
referenceEn: We'll wrap up this class in ten minutes.
We are going to wrap up the lesson in ten minutes.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「結束」（例如 wrap up this class 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 finish this class、end the lesson 等）
用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、are going to 等）；寫現在進行式 are wrapping up 也正確
「這堂課」可寫，例如 this class、the lesson 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「撕下來」是 tear down 的另一個常見意思（tear down a poster／notice＝把海報撕下來），當干擾項不妥。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：tear down 干擾項「撕下來」（tear down a poster）換成「組裝」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「包裝」是 wrap up 的另一個非常常見的意思（wrap up a present＝把禮物包好），當干擾項不妥。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：wrap up 干擾項「包裝」（wrap up a present）換成「試用」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案："I always stick to decisions once I make them." 缺所有格不道地，母語者會說 stick to my decisions。
